summary.plain: The underground cavern at Point 2 of the LEP ring, near the French village of Sergy, where the L3 detector recorded electron-positron collisions from 1989 to 2000. The same cavern and L3's huge magnet were later reused for the ALICE experiment.
summary.technical: LEP interaction point 2, in Sergy (Ain, France); housed the L3 detector for the full LEP programme. L3's solenoid magnet was left in place and is now ALICE's central magnet at the same point.
